newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Court approves Advance, St George merger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Court approves Advance, St George merger.

text.p: New South Wales Supreme Court Judge Kim Santow on Thursday approved a scheme of arrangement to merge Advance Bank Australia Ltd and St George Bank Ltd.
The ruling paves the way for the merger of the two banks.
The merger now depends on the outcome of an Advance Bank shareholder meeting on January 13 to alter the bank's articles of association.
"I am satisfied that this scheme of arrangement should be approved in these particular circumstances," Santow said.

Under the merger proposal St George Bank will offer Advance Bank ordinary shareholders 0.625 of a new St George Bank ordinary share, A$2.10 in cash from St George and a 20-cent per share special dividend for each Advance Bank share.
The special dividend would be franked to about 60 percent.
Advance Bank ordinary shareholders would also receive an interim fully franked dividend of 20 cents per share.
The offer values Advance at over A$2.6 billion.
The terms set were based on the weighted average St George Bank share price, ex-final dividend, in the 20 business days up to January 3, of A$7.90.
St George shares were trading at A$7.64, down three cents, before being suspended from trading late on Thursday.
Advance Bank shares, which were also suspended, were up three cents at A$7.03.

National Australia Bank Ltd has a three percent stake in Advance and 6.8 percent of St George. NAB, which is seen as interested in buying regional banks, has not said whether it opposes the merger and did not appear at the hearing.

A spokesman for Advance Bank said the merger was now on track for completion by January 29 and that he was confident shareholders would approve the change in the bank's articles of association which would allow an investor to own more than 10 percent of the bank's shares.
"Given the overwhelming support at the last shareholders' meeting, I expect shareholders to approve the change at Monday's meeting," he said.
